definition: Executed application-protocol dependency layers on the critical schedule: FC preflight; each SPFSS manifest; DPF A/B/C semantic layers reported by the DPF implementation; each public-polynomial exchange; each Ring-OLE completion agreement and derandomization opening; for every conversion chunk its preflight, three sequential correlation-generation layers, masked-input opening, and post-mask ripple/opening dependencies; final conversion agreement; and the two commit agreements. Excludes socket connection and the selected OT backend's opaque setup schedule. Instrumentation adds no protocol exchange. It is not a direction-switch or packet/network-round count. Per-party rows report the process value; the model summary reports the sum across retained layers of max(p0,p1) for each layer.
Always NA: SCI does not expose its internal Naor-Pinkas base-OT dependency schedule, and emp-silent does not expose a non-overlapping base-OT schedule, so no zero or inferred count is emitted.
steady_clock wall time for the common manifest/local-validity exchange only, starting after both PartyChannel sockets are constructed; excludes connection and OT setup.

steady_clock wall time for PartyChannel::setup_ots. For sci-iknp this includes both directional 128-base-OT batches and flushes; for emp-silent it includes both SilentFerret begin/setup sessions, including correlation generation.
Sum across executed Ring-OLE instances of DPF Phase A wall time: correlated carry triples and the dependent carry-opening chain; excludes SPFSS grouping.
Sum across executed Ring-OLE instances of DPF Phase B wall time: the level-synchronous GPU frontier, OT selection, and correction-word openings; excludes SPFSS grouping.
Sum across executed Ring-OLE instances of DPF Phase C wall time: three-OLE final payload correction through the finalCW opening; excludes SPFSS grouping.
Sum of wall time spent moving generated flat DPF keys into the exact GroupedHostKeys consumer layout; excludes DPF generation and party-noise batch construction.

Sum of wall time to materialize fixed a_0=1, sample and encode the (c-1)*n random coefficient shares for a_1 through a_(c-1), exchange them, validate the peer shares, and combine the public Ring-LPN vector.
Sum of wall time inside expand_ring_ole_party after host keys are packed, including its GPU work and required synchronization.
Sum of wall time to form, exchange, validate, and consume Ring-OLE operand openings and accumulate cross terms.

Sum of complete secure-conversion chunk wall times, including each conversion preflight, correlation generation, online ripple/openings, result copying, and local CRT lift preparation; no conversion sub-time is added again to this field.
Wall time to assemble A||B||C, serialize and hash the party-local record, write its temporary file, and set owner-only permissions; ends before the first bilateral publication agreement.
Wall time from the first bilateral publication agreement through rename and the second bilateral rename agreement; includes failure cleanup reached in that interval.
Legacy encompassing party critical-path wall time from after OT setup through commit, retained for comparability; stage fields are partitions/details and must not be added to total_us.
Checker-side synchronized wall time for the two matched stock dealer gpuKeygenMatmul/gpuKeygenConv2D calls; excludes checker and online-consumer time.
Checker-side synchronized wall time for the unchanged two-share gpuMatmulBeaver/gpuConv2DBeaver consumer calls; excludes checker and dealer-baseline time.

Checker wall time outside the disjoint matched-dealer and online-consumer timed intervals: record validation, expected-value construction, key parsing, GPU setup/copies, synchronization outside those timers, result validation, and cleanup.

Linux getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss process-lifetime high-water mark sampled once immediately before row emission and converted from KiB with checked multiplication by 1024; NA on syscall/range failure. Party and checker processes report separately.

Maximum device-wide CUDA total_bytes-free_bytes observed at explicit stage boundaries, not an allocation-exact or process-attributable peak. Party samples after GPU-pool initialization, every Ring-LPN expansion, AES-context release, and commit; checker samples after pool initialization, dealer baseline, online consumer, and frees. NA if any cudaMemGetInfo sample fails or no sample succeeds.
Minimum device-wide free bytes from the same cudaMemGetInfo boundary samples used for peak_gpu_bytes; NA under the same conditions.

Local SCI straight-stream NetIO send counter snapshotted after commit. Includes preflight, base-OT setup, application protocol, and commit and excludes TCP/IP framing; instrumentation adds no metrics message.

In publication result CSVs, the peer's post-exit straight-stream sent snapshot, hence bytes this process received on the SCI straight stream, with the same scope as transport_straight_bytes_sent. A live party row emits NA because it cannot read peer state.
Local SCI reversed-stream NetIO send counter snapshotted after commit, with the same inclusion/exclusion scope as transport_straight_bytes_sent.

In publication result CSVs, the peer's post-exit reversed-stream sent snapshot, hence bytes this process received on the SCI reversed stream, with the same scope as transport_straight_bytes_sent. A live party row emits NA because it cannot read peer state.

Actual PartyChannel Naor-Pinkas base-OT counter for sci-iknp; the current successful SCI setup records 256 base OTs, one 128-OT batch per direction. NA for emp-silent because its backend does not expose a non-overlapping base-OT count.

For sci-iknp, checked sum of local straight and reversed NetIO sent-byte deltas measured only inside setup_ots. NA for emp-silent because its setup_ots delta contains SilentFerret correlation traffic reported separately and cannot be labelled base-OT-only without double counting.
In publication result CSVs for sci-iknp, the peer's checked base_ot_setup_bytes_sent value, hence bytes locally received during base-OT setup. A live party row and every emp-silent row emit NA.

yes for sci-iknp when local transport snapshots are available and include its explicitly measured base-OT setup. NA for emp-silent because the backend does not expose non-overlapping base-OT-only traffic. Post-exit publication aggregators reconstruct SCI receive fields from peer sent snapshots.
Legacy application send counter from after OT setup through commit, retained unchanged and therefore excluding preflight and base-OT setup.
Legacy sum of SCI NetIO send/receive direction transitions from after OT setup through commit; not a dependency-round or network-packet count.

Model-scale summary field pattern: per trial max(p0_stage_us,p1_stage_us) for each named party stage, followed by the reported sample statistics; a trial is omitted for that metric if either party value is NA.
Model-scale summary per-trial minimum of the two party min_gpu_free_bytes values; a trial is omitted for this metric if either party value is NA.
Model-scale summary per-trial sum of p0/p1 straight/reversed sent-byte snapshots. Each wire payload is counted once and base-OT bytes are included; a trial is omitted if any source value is NA.
Model-scale summary per-trial sum of both parties' base_ot_setup_bytes_sent values, counting each wire payload once; a trial is omitted if either value is NA.

Public 128-bit high-entropy base invocation ID. Both parties and the checker must emit the same value; a persistent consume-once ledger rejects every duplicate/retry/restart before OT or CSPRNG state is consumed.

SHA-256 digest of the immutable canonical consume claim binding invocation_id, party-independent layer identity, and exact correlation plan. The two party records and checker must agree; the private append-only ledger itself is never public evidence.
Selected OT backend for this process. sci-iknp is the existing SCI SplitIKNP path; emp-silent is the pinned EMP SilentFerret bridge. NA means backend selection did not complete.
Exact backend provenance emitted by the selected implementation: the pinned SCI revision/name or the exact lowercase 40-hex EMP commit. It is not a security-review claim.

Checked local straight-stream backend send-counter delta around silent correlation generation. Includes backend wire framing and excludes the fixed launcher/control channel. NA for a backend that cannot expose this boundary.
In publication result CSVs, the peer's ot_correlation_straight_bytes_sent value, hence locally received straight-stream silent-correlation bytes. A live party row emits NA.
Checked local reversed-stream backend send-counter delta around silent correlation generation, with the same boundary as ot_correlation_straight_bytes_sent.
In publication result CSVs, the peer's ot_correlation_reversed_bytes_sent value, hence locally received reversed-stream silent-correlation bytes. A live party row emits NA.
Checked encoded payload bytes locally sent for packed selected-OT adjustment messages after correlation generation; excludes ciphertext payloads and backend correlation traffic.
In publication result CSVs, the peer's ot_adjustment_bytes_sent value, hence packed selected-OT adjustment payload bytes locally received. A live party row emits NA.
Checked encoded payload bytes locally sent for packed selected-OT ciphertext messages; excludes adjustment payloads and backend correlation traffic.
In publication result CSVs, the peer's ot_ciphertext_bytes_sent value, hence packed selected-OT ciphertext payload bytes locally received. A live party row emits NA.
Number of 128-bit straight-direction silent-OT inventory entries made available to the application by the backend for this invocation.
Number of declared straight-direction 128-bit silent-OT inventory entries actually consumed; must not exceed ot_inventory_straight_declared.
Number of 128-bit reversed-direction silent-OT inventory entries made available to the application by the backend for this invocation.
Number of declared reversed-direction 128-bit silent-OT inventory entries actually consumed; must not exceed ot_inventory_reversed_declared.
Review/measurement gate label for the selected backend revision. unreviewed-unmeasured explicitly prohibits treating an emp-silent row as publication evidence; NA means no status was established.
Literal unavailable sentinel. A stage not observed or a failed syscall/CUDA/counter-range check is emitted as NA, never numeric zero.
